text:
sam: deploybot blocked the prod-cut during the change window. artifact verify failed with checksum mismatch on the promoted manifest.
anya: that's the new cache-ttl pruning change we shipped last night right?
tom: yeah, we shortened cache TTL for the build cache to speed GC. I wonder if the registry index had a stale blob reference.
infra: logs: `artifact-verify: manifest digest mismatch: expected sha256:ab12.. got sha256:ff34..` for image docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-20-7c4d1e.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion halted at step=verify-artifacts; last-known-good=docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-19-3b9a0f. To force continue: `deploybot promote --to-image 3b9a0f --force --reason "manual-pin-checksum-fail"`
pm-lina: PMs asking if we should roll back or wait for rebuild. timeline?
sam: we have two safe options: 1) manual-pin to last-known-good and proceed with prod cut, 2) rebuild the CI artifact with a fresh push and re-run verification (takes ~20m). Which is lower risk?
tom: rebuild may hit the same cache-pruned blob if registry GC removed older blobs. If the last-known-good is already in registry, pinning is fastest.
anya: agree - pin now, then follow up with infra to disable aggressive TTL and add an integrity check in the cache tombstone flow.
infra: opening ticket INF-1029 to revert TTL to previous value and add hedged fetch for blobs. Also investigating why digest mapping flipped during index compaction.
deploy-bot: note: pinning will keep previous manifest but we must re-run smoke and canary. Use `deploybot promote --to-image 3b9a0f --reason "pin-due-to-checksum-mismatch"`
sam: anya, can you run the promote and start canary? I'll update release notes and notify customers if prod cut slips.
anya: running now: `deploybot promote --to-image 3b9a0f --reason "pin-for-prod-cut"`
deploy-bot: Promotion started. verifying health checks. canary rollout 10%.
pm-lina: i'll change the release notes: "prod cut pinned to previous stable image 3b9a0f due to artifact verification failure; follow-up: cache-ttl revert and blob integrity fixes."
sam: if canary passes, proceed to prod with manual approval. schedule postmortem to cover release blocker and cache GC change.
tom: adding unit/regression test to prevent digest remapping in index compaction.
infra: GC revert deployed to staging, rolling to prod after tests. Ticket INF-1029 updated.
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded in staging. Prod cut remains manual pending PM approval.
anya: done, notified PMs. closing thread for now.
